item.title: Siddaramaiah: Karnataka's Record-Breaking CM or Biggest Borrower?
item.description: Siddaramaiah: Karnataka's Record-Breaking CM or Biggest Borrower? The Opposition BJP has labeled Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah as the state's 'biggest borrowing CM'.This critique comes on the day Siddaramaiah was acknowledged as Karnataka's longest-serving Chief Minister.The BJP claims borrowing Rs 93,000 crore in one quarter signals fiscal mismanagement.
